in_sanskrit.name: Brindita
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Krishna's beloved
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Brindita एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Brindita is a Sanskrit name that originates from the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata. It refers to the beloved of Lord Krishna, evoking images of the divine romantic connection between the two. Brindita is also believed to symbolize the divine feminine, grace, and love.
